summary: Our project is called Junior Astronaut Mission trainer, we develop a Genially game where the players get to experience a 7 day mission to Mars, where they have different challenges like electrical failure and oxygen leaks, that they have to solve. With this game players can learn more about Mars and the problems the astronauts face during space missions. Our goal is to inspire the new generations especially those children who want to be astronauts when they grow up.
details: Our project is called Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. It's a game where you get to go on a 7-day mission to Mars. You'll play and learn about space travel by doing tasks and dealing with problems that real astronauts might face on a trip to space. The benefits that it haves is that you learn about space, problem solving skils. The inteded impact is to inspire young people to learn more about space or be an astronaut in the future. We used Genially, Canva, Remove.bg, and ChatGPT to create most of the images. It is creative because it includes space adventure, interactive missions and aalien that makes the story more fun. We considered the astronauts' food, water, oxygen, energy, safety, and limited supplies.
